name: TRMNL client (colour, indexed PNG)
description: Composition PNG quantised to an indexed PNG matched to a Spectra 6 / Waveshare E6 / ACeP colour panel, delivered over the same TRMNL BYOS /api/display path as the 1-bit trmnl_png renderer. Targets colour ePaper panels that ship with TRMNL-compatible firmware, notably the Seeed reTerminal E1002 (7.3" 6-colour Spectra 6). Server-side Floyd-Steinberg dither runs against the panel's native palette so the device just paints what arrives, no on-device quantise pass. Falls back to Waveshare E6 nominal for panels that haven't declared a gamut so a custom Spectra panel still produces a sensible indexed image rather than 24-bit RGB.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
